posts.name: Spiff
posts.cooked:
I’ve been doing some pre-Photoshop work so that as soon as I get my hands on the expansion (sadly mine hasn’t arrived on the west coast yet), I can toss the rules onto the already-arted-up pages and print them out for immediate play. The card boxes and oversized environment cards don’t have any rules on them though, so I was able to finish them completely and I figured I’d post them up early in case anyone wants to fire up their printers while they wait for the FedEx truck to arrive.

Once I have all the new stuff ready to go, I’ll update the .zip file and make a note of it in the “Spiff’s SotM Accessories” topic.

For now though, you can get the Rook City card boxes and oversized environment cards here: http://www.spiffworld.com/temp_files/sotm_rook_city_expansion.zip.  Enjoy.
